reasons: The lake identity record verifies Henry v. United States, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1959-11-23, year 1959.
The lake citations list official citation 361 U.S. 98, parallel citations 80 S. Ct. 168 and 4 L. Ed. 2d 134, and vendor citation 1959 U.S. LEXIS 89.
The opinion text header independently shows 361 U.S. 98 (1959) and Supreme Court of United States.
The opinion states that the issue was probable cause for the arrest leading to the search.
The opinion gives the probable-cause standard, applies it to the agents' warrantless arrest, and reverses because probable cause did not exist when the car was stopped.
That makes the case substantively central to a Probable Cause page.
residual_risks: No separate disclosed taxonomy defines the exact corpus meaning of Anchor.

defect.evidence_quote: The police must have reasonable grounds to believe that the particular package carried by the citizen is contraband. Its shape and design might at times be adequate. The weight of it and the manner in which it is carried might at times be enough.
defect.problem: The core holding is supported, but the phrase that outwardly innocent conduct or mere package movement does not supply probable cause is too categorical unless limited to this record and the absence of additional contraband indicators.
defect.proposed_fix: Probable cause for this warrantless arrest was judged at the time agents stopped the car; on this record, the vague Pierotti tip and residential-alley carton movements, without signs the cartons contained contraband, were insufficient, and later-discovered contraband could not justify the arrest.

reasons: The text supports judging probable cause at the car stop: the arrest was complete when the officers restricted liberty and the Court asked whether they had reasonable cause at or before that time.
The text supports the later-search point: an arrest is not justified by what the subsequent search discloses.

The text also qualifies the package-movement reasoning, so the holding should be framed as fact-specific rather than a broad rule that outwardly innocent package conduct can never support probable cause.
residual_risks: The lake record has no separate holding field; support review rests on the cached opinion text and pinpoints.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add 'on this record' and mention the lack of signs that the cartons were contraband.
